import sys, json, random
sys.path.insert(0,'project'); sys.path.insert(0,'dev')
import collector
from collector import Case, PRIM_INDEX
from fuzz import gen_case
from fuzz2 import gen as gen2
# force python path
collector._FNV = None
rng = random.Random(9)
bad=0
for i in range(400):
    case = gen_case(rng) if i%2 else gen2(rng)
    a = Case(PRIM_INDEX[case['primitive']], case['mode'], case['root'],
             case['segments'], case['words'], case['capacity'], case['start'], 0)
    a.replay(case['events'])
    py = a.digest()
    collector._FNV = collector.use_accelerator()
    b = Case(PRIM_INDEX[case['primitive']], case['mode'], case['root'],
             case['segments'], case['words'], case['capacity'], case['start'], 0)
    b.replay(case['events'])
    cval = b.digest()
    if py != cval:
        bad += 1; print('MISMATCH', json.dumps(case), hex(py), hex(cval))
        if bad>2: break
    collector._FNV = None
print('digest cross-check failures', bad, 'accel available:', collector.use_accelerator() is not None)
EOF
